import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendCaveLogs } from '@src/api/bot/cave-queries';
import { sendCavePlotLogPage, sendLingzhiGuidePromptPage, sendProfessionAndCaveLockedPage } from '@src/response/cavePlot/render';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const pageMatch = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim().match(/(?:灵田|洞府)记录(?:\s+p?(\d+))?$/);
  const page = pageMatch?.[1] ? Number(pageMatch[1]) : 1;
  const logResult = await getBackendCaveLogs(bid, uid, page);

  if (!logResult.canUseCave) {
    sendProfessionAndCaveLockedPage({
      title: '洞府记录',
      bid,
      isPrivate,
      message,
      leadText: logResult.lockedMessage
    });

    return;
  }

  if (!logResult.hasCavePlot) {
    sendLingzhiGuidePromptPage({
      title: '洞府记录',
      bid,
      isPrivate,
      message
    });

    return;
  }

  sendCavePlotLogPage({
    title: '洞府记录',
    bid,
    isPrivate,
    message,
    logs: logResult.logs,
    page: logResult.page,
    totalPages: logResult.totalPages,
    total: logResult.total
  });
});
